title: Mischa Markow
notes: ~280 individual articles A-Z; very high KG value (each = concept node)

footnotes.text: Kahlile B. Mehr,Mormon Missionaries Enter Eastern Europe(Provo, Utah: Brigham Young University Press, 2002), 5–8.

In Belgium, Markow taught and eventually baptized the Esselmann family; he then immigrated to Utah in 1892. See Matthew K. Heiss, “Wherever I Went, I Preached the Gospel,” in Richard E. Turley Jr., ed.,Behold, There Shall Be a Record Kept among You: Collections of the Church History Library of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints(Salt Lake City: Church History Library, 2009), 56; Mehr,Mormon Missionaries Enter Eastern Europe,352–56.
In Utah, Markow married Jonetha “Nettie” Hansen and had three children.
See Topic:Turkish Mission. Mehr,Mormon Missionaries Enter Eastern Europe,32–34.
